svg.title: Timeline of the pull_request_target guards in 2026
svg.desc: actions/checkout v7.0.0 was tagged on June 17, 2026 and the v2 to v6 major tags were moved on July 16 to releases with the fork checkout guard. Workflow execution protections reached general availability on September 17 with a default pull_request_target rule in evaluate mode. On October 21 enforcement moved from November 2 to December 2. Brownouts ran on November 9 and November 16 from 16:00 to 18:00 UTC. Permanent enforcement starts December 2, 2026.
svg.text: Two guards, rolled out on two tracks
Green: actions/checkout release track. Blue, amber, red: Actions event policy track.
refuses fork PR checkout in pull_request_target and workflow_run
v2, v3, v4, v5, v6 tags moved
default rule added, evaluate mode only
blocked runs fail with an error annotation
same as brownout 1, then back to evaluate
public repos with no applicable event policy
Sources: actions/checkout git tags and CHANGELOG, GitHub changelog 2026-09-17 and 2026-11-02.
